observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor ballroom performance stage with a live orchestra in the background and seated audience members along the perimeter.
observation.dancers: One couple: one man and one woman.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers enter down a set of stairs from the orchestra platform onto a large open wooden dance floor, moving around the space together and sometimes separating briefly.
observation.posture: Upright and elongated torso with straight legs during steps; active use of hip movement.
observation.footwork: Latin dancing footwork with straight knees on forward and backward steps, articulating through the ball of the foot with Cuban motion.
observation.arms_and_hands: Dynamic arm styling, overhead extensions, single-hand holds, and open framing.
observation.hips_and_torso: Pronounced hip action and ribcage movement typical of Latin dance.
observation.partnering: Paired dancing with alternating closed frames, open holds, spins away from each other, and returning to contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Turns on the ball of the foot, spinning underarm, no aerial jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: Man wears a black button-down shirt with patterned details, black trousers, and dance shoes. Woman wears a sparkling green fringed Latin dance dress and tan strappy heels.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact weight distribution details due to low-resolution video compression.

signature_moments.what: The couple walks downstage with synchronized chassé steps and hip motion.
Closed hold position while turning and stepping together with continuous hip action.
The couple separates, each performing solo turning and arm styling before coming back together.
